title: Trump and Putin will speak this week on Russia-Ukraine war, US envoy says
description: President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin are expected to speak this week as the U.S. tries to broker a ceasefire in the Russia-Ukraine war, according to Trump special envoy Steve Witkoff.

title: Ukraine war latest: Head of Ukrainian army replaced - as battles rage on in Russia's Kursk region
description: Volodymyr Zelenskyy has replaced the head of the Ukrainian army, according to the country's defence minister. Andrii Hnatov replaces Anatoliy Bargylevych, who only took the role in February last year. Meanwhile, battles rage on in the Kursk region.
